translated_text: 11.6.40 Everything's going very well, I'm working as before. I'm waiting to hear from you. I hope you're well, my darling, and that you arrived safely at your new post office. You see, I didn't think you'd let me tell you. Write to me often because things move so fast with the post office now. Stay calm, my little one, even if you don't receive any letters. I adore you, my little wife, your Bob. MILITARY FRANCHISE PRIORITY FRENCH REPUBLIC POSTCARD TO THE ARMED FORCES This card is sold for 5 cents in all Post Offices.
